title: Carl Sagan's early UFO interest and turn to skepticism

tellings.quote: Carl Sean who grew up writing about UFOs in his diary and would debate with his mentor all the time about them and then somehow flipped into being super anti- UFO you know him writing the demon Haunted World

plain: The astronomer Carl Sagan grew up writing about UFOs in his diary and argued about them constantly with his mentor, then somehow turned strongly against them, according to Michels. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation with the religion scholar Diana Pasulka. He points to Sagan's book The Demon-Haunted World as the mark of that turn and treats the change as a puzzle worth asking about.
